leaders.name: Rt. Rev. Joseph Mamer Manot
leaders.bio: The first Bishop of the Diocese, Bishop Joseph leads Wanyjok with a vision for mission, discipleship, and raising up faithful Christian leaders across Aweil East.

leaders.name: Rev. Canon William Manut Akot
leaders.bio: As Provost, Rev. Canon William oversees worship and the spiritual life at the heart of the Diocese, shepherding the cathedral congregation.

leaders.name: Mr. Luka Lual Lual Ngong
leaders.bio: Luka keeps the Diocese organised, coordinating meetings, records, resolutions, and the annual plans that keep ministry moving forward.

leaders.name: Rev'd Clarice Achieng Mamer
leaders.bio: Rev'd Clarice leads the Mother's Union across the Diocese, setting its direction and prayer life, and reports jointly to the Bishop and the Diocesan Administrative Secretary.

leaders.name: Elisabeth Abuk Akot
leaders.bio: Elisabeth leads the Mothers' Union, guiding its yearly plan, meetings, and prayer days, and the women who form a prayerful backbone of the Diocese.
